> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Opening it the first time:** this build isn't notarized by Apple yet, so macOS may say *"Apple could not verify NotchBar is free of malware"*. That's expected; don't move it to the Trash.
> 1. Click **Done**.
> 2. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and scroll down to Security.
> 3. Click **Open Anyway** next to NotchBar, then confirm with your password. You only do this once.

## Install
1. Download **NotchBar-x.y.z.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **NotchBar** onto **Applications**.
3. Open NotchBar from Applications. A setup window walks you through connecting Claude Code, Open at login and Terminal tab jumping.

Requires macOS 13 or later. Runs on Apple Silicon and Intel.
